g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure Databricks lakehouse on ADLS Gen2 with Data Factory ingestion from on-premises

g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: A schedule trigger starts the nightly Data Factory pipeline
The self-hosted integration runtime picks up the copy activity from Data Factory over its private endpoint
It reads the ERP and CRM databases in the data centre over the site-to-site VPN
and lands the rows as Parquet in the bronze container of ADLS Gen2
The pipeline then starts the Databricks job through the workspace's private endpoint
Spark jobs clean bronze into silver Delta tables and aggregate silver into gold
Analysts open the Power BI reports
which query the gold tables through a Databricks SQL warehouse; Purview catalogues the lake
